MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk card fits my repeated purchases of memory cards and camera accessories. More photo storage feels useful, provided my equipment supports SDXC.",
    "The outlet extender fits my purchases of power strips and charging cables because its spaced outlets and USB ports could help connect my devices.",
    "A streaming stick could add a useful viewing option alongside my TV and DVD player, although my listed TV would not benefit from 4K."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and displays introduce uses I have not shown a need for. Owning a Fire tablet does not mean I want voice controls or another small screen.",
    "The headphones and AirPods do not address my current interest in camera accessories and practical connections. My older Apple charging cable does not establish a need for wireless earbuds.",
    "The 16TB drive connects loosely to photo storage, but I have not shown a need for that capacity. The second streaming stick would duplicate my choice, and its themed cover gives me no additional reason to buy it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been taken as interest in several other Amazon devices, even though they serve different purposes.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in new gadgets, when many were specific accessories for equipment I already use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of tripods, memory cards, a card reader and a lens cap suggest an ongoing need to support camera use and manage photos.",
    "Compatibility matters: card format, cable connector and the capabilities of my existing devices affect whether an accessory is useful.",
    "I often choose items that solve a concrete connection, charging or storage problem. A larger capacity or an additional device needs a clear purpose for me."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized some storage and power needs but stretched my device ownership into interest in gadgets without a clear use for me."
}
